Subject: Trial extension + evaluation credits request

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the quick start guide earlier. We completed initial integration this week and ran a few pipelines against the default model, but we hit token limits while stress-testing a few conversation flows. Our security team also needs time to run the SOC2 checklist (they asked for 4–6 weeks).

We’d like to request a short trial extension (additional 60 days) and a one-off evaluation credit to cover approximately 50k tokens so we can validate latency and cost under expected loads. If you need a short statement of use/case, here it is: BrightSite is integrating Redwood to power our contextual customer support assistant across web and mobile (English + Spanish). The pilot target is ~25k monthly active users, low-latency 50–150 token responses.

If there’s an approval form or a PO required, let me know — we’re trying to move fast and could sign a simple pilot agreement. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
